detected_fault: One earbud not charging, possibly due to damaged or dropped charge case
suggested_solution: Crack open the bottom half of the charging assembly circuit board by releasing the clips on either side of the bottom half.
Remove the top part of the clamshell and gently separate the two bottom sections, being mindful of the wires.
Carefully move the battery off to the side to reveal the screw points.
Tighten the screws that hold the charging assembly circuit board to the underside of the middle part of the charge case.
Fold the battery back in place and fold the thin wires towards the interior to avoid clamping them between the plastic.
